final_observable_contract: On Windows, an MCP stdio server configured with bare uv or uvx resolves an executable in the active Hermes profile bin, then the current user's .local/bin, when the child PATH lacks the launcher. A child PATH hit retains precedence, the selected directory enters the child PATH, and unrelated commands keep their existing behavior.
